name: manual_b88743
claim: EnterWorktree's default base branches from the repo's fresh default remote branch (e.g. origin/main), NOT whatever branch you actually need to work on. If the task is to fix something on an existing PR/feature branch, the worktree starts on the wrong branch -- immediately fetch and checkout the real target branch inside the new worktree (git fetch origin <branch>:<branch> && git checkout <branch>) before making any edits, rather than assuming the worktree already has the right content.

decisions.notes: Created a worktree for PR #208 CodeRabbit fixes (2026-07-12); it started on a fresh auto-generated branch from main, not PR #208's actual branch (2026-07-11-004-agentic-stack-upgrade-v0.18). Had to fetch+checkout the real branch before the target files even existed in the worktree.
